shareholders.evidence: to maximize Berkshire’s average annual rate of gain in intrinsic business value on a per-share basis

integrity.evidence: We will be candid in our reporting to you, emphasizing the pluses and minuses important in appraising business value.

result.analyst_notes: Written in the first person by Chairman Warren Buffett, addressing shareholders as owner-partners. Tone is reflective and candid, mixing hedged expectations (we hope, we expect) with absolute pledges (we will never sell good businesses). Shareholder returns and candor dominate; employees, customers and community are barely addressed. Folksy metaphors such as eggs-in-one-basket and gin rummy give the wording a distinctive voice.
